# OCSP fixtures generated by OpenSSL

Independent test vectors for `crates/tls/src/ocsp` (SEC-MEDIUM D1): they were produced by the
OpenSSL CLI (3.5.3), not by caddy-rs's own DER builders, so a shared misreading of RFC 6960
between the in-test builder and the parser cannot hide.

Each directory holds `leaf.der` (a P-256 leaf with an AIA OCSP URL and a serial whose high bit
is set, so its INTEGER carries a `00` prefix), `issuer.der` (the CA) and `response.der` (the
OCSP response, exactly as `openssl ocsp` wrote it).

| directory | CA key | status | responder | responder ID | nonce |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rsa2048-direct-byname-good-nonce` | RSA-2048 | good | the CA | byName | yes |
| `p256-direct-bykey-good-nonce-none` | P-256 | good | the CA | byKey | no |
| `p384-direct-byname-revoked-keycompromise` | P-384 | revoked (keyCompromise) | the CA | byName | yes |
| `ed25519-direct-byname-good` | Ed25519 | good | the CA | byName | yes |
| `rsa2048-delegated-byname-good` | RSA-2048 | good | delegate (P-256, EKU OCSPSigning) | byName | yes |
| `p256-delegated-bykey-revoked-superseded` | P-256 | revoked (superseded) | delegate (P-384) | byKey | no |
| `p384-delegated-byname-good-ed25519-responder` | P-384 | good | delegate (Ed25519) | byName | yes |

Certificates are valid for 100 years from generation and responses carry `nextUpdate` ten years
after `thisUpdate`; the tests inject `now = thisUpdate + 1h`, so they never depend on the wall
clock.

Regenerate with `bash generate.sh <output-dir>` (needs `openssl`); every run produces new keys
and new bytes, and the tests only depend on the properties in the table above.
